data_fields.name: bars_hide_beyond
data_fields.donor_constant: none in donor (no hysteresis); proposed 30 for the sketch

data_fields.name: hp_bar_length_px
data_fields.donor_constant: not read (_BatLength is set outside this function)

best_idea: Show an enemy's HP bar only inside a short range where the server keeps the value fresh, keep the targeting-you marker out to a longer range, and give the bar a hysteresis band so it does not flicker at the edge.
decision_why: The two-range split (marker further out than the bar) suits a many-on-one fight, but the donor shows and hides at the same threshold; the band fixes that, and the negative-HP and forage parts do not transfer.
acceptance: In a fight, an enemy inside the bar range shows its HP bar; walking across the edge does not flicker the bar (it stays until the enemy is beyond the band); a unit that targets the player shows the marker out to the marker range; a unit beyond the bar range shows no HP value. A unit test asserts the band and the marker range.
